description: Elections Commission - P. J. Perera of the Kotikawatta, Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the United National Party - I. R. M. Gamage of the Kotikawatta Mulleriyawa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated her office of the member of the United National Party - T. N. Naanthota of the Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of United National Party
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific members of the Homagama Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of the United National Party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and local government member status, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including candidate registrations, vacancies, and electoral commission decisions.
